summary: Tested QRU Distribution Architecture Phase 0 end-to-end. All 9 backend tests pass (auth guards, seeded 5 experiences in exact order, destinations-map matches approved table exactly, resolve returns defaults and fallback, plug-in registration works with duplicate/empty rejection, regression on /api/consumer/catalog and /api/public/home passes). Frontend page /distribution-architecture renders correctly: 3 principle cards, 3-layer flow with 5 experiences, experiences section, all 12 approved map rows visible, register-experience dialog opens, save creates a new card immediately (verified 'QRU Academy Test' appears without page reload). Code-review of manufacturing_foundation.publish_product: both 'publication' and 'other-engine' branches correctly apply Automatic Distribution — Founder override wins, else recommend_destinations; auto_assigned + assigned_at set as required. Note: a stray 'qa-test-exp' experience remains in DB from the test — main agent stated they will clean up.

issues: Radix Dialog warning: missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby (accessibility warning only, not blocking)

action_items: Cleanup: remove the 'qa-test-exp' and 'qru-academy-XXXX' experiences created during testing from distribution_experiences collection (as stated by main agent).
Optional a11y: add DialogDescription to Register Experience dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Automatic Distribution logic in manufacturing_foundation.publish_product correctly branches: override preserved (auto_assigned:false) vs default recommendation (auto_assigned:true). Verified in both publication and non-publication engine branches.

distribution_architecture.register_experience normalizes id (lowercase, hyphenated) and returns error dicts (not HTTP errors) for validation failures — client checks data.error which is consistent with UI code.
seed_experiences is idempotent (upsert with $setOnInsert for founder_locked/builtin/registered_at), safe on restart.
MongoDB _id properly excluded via projection and doc.pop after insert.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral experiences during test: 'qa-test-exp' via backend test and 'qru-academy-XXXX' via UI test. Main agent to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Distribution Architecture Phase 0 is functional. Automatic Distribution defaults for product publish are code-verified; runtime publish path not exercised (needs manufactured product with real deliverable). Prev iteration 96 covered Store readiness.
